rewards: 4 x Antique Lamp (20,000 Exp. Any Combat Skill, excluding prayer)

st.t: Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza.
s: What's this thing you need from me?

st.t: Enter the crypts north east of the Mysterious Stranger.
Kill a vyrewatch for a key. You must have your flail equipped in order to damage the vyrewatches.
Unlock the crypt gate with the key.
Search the coffin.
Return to the Mysterious Stranger with Ranis' head.
s: I managed to recover Ranis' head.

st.t: Speak to the Mysterious Stranger some more.
s: So what are we doing with Ranis' head?

st.t: Enter the spider cave south of Port Phasmatys.
Search the skeleton found near the Egg Sac at the end of the cave.
Read the Sticky note.

Leave the spider cave the way you came in. In Slepe, go down the ladder south of the graveyard into the Sisterhood Sanctuary. Follow the corridor a little north, a long way east, around the bend to the south-east, then north, east and north again to the stairs. Climb them and speak with Daer Krand in the north east corner of the main room.
Return to the spider cave south of Port Phasmatys then use the Sulphuric acid on the Egg sac at the end of the cave.
Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza again with the spider eggs retrieved from the Egg sac. Use the Drakan's Medallion tele to get to Ver Sinhaza quickly.
s: I found some of those eggs.

st.t: Watch cutscenes.
Go to the Nature Grotto in the Mort Myre Swamp and speak with the Nature Spirit inside. Use fairy ring BIP (with 50 agility) to get there quickly.

Leave the grotto and go to the island directly east of it: walk west, north, then east around the swamp to the stepping stone on the island's west side and cross it. Be prepared to fight Hespori. The fight is similar to what you would expect from the Hespori fight in the Farming Guild. Activate Hespori when ready.
Fight Hespori.
Chop Hespori to obtain Hespori bark.
Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza again with the Hespori bark. Use the Drakan's Medallion tele to get to Ver Sinhaza quickly.
Watch cutscenes.
Complete the Theatre of Blood.
Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza and watch the cutscenes to finish the quest.
s: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?
